subject: english
stem: The path was hard to see. After lamps were installed, more people used it at night. What relation is best supported?
options: The lamps helped make night use easier
Night users caused the lamps to disappear
The lamps proved every path is safe

optionRationales.reason: The lamps helped make night use easier：可見性問題、加燈與夜用增加形成機制。
Night users caused the lamps to disappear：方向與事實相反。
The lamps proved every path is safe：擴張到 every path。
The path became shorter：長度未變。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「事件先後、機制與結果共同支持原因方向」可推出 The lamps helped make night use easier；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The lamps helped make night use easier 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
